learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore the different things around us, what they look like, and how they feel to touch!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Everything we see in our room, like a wooden table, a plastic toy, or a paper book, is an object. They come in many beautiful shapes, bright colors, and sizes!
Some objects like a fluffy teddy bear feel very soft and nice when we hug them. Other objects like a wooden chair or a stone feel very hard to touch.
A big fat book or a large rock is very heavy to lift with our hands. But a beautiful floating balloon or a tiny feather is so light it can fly in the wind!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Sorting Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Walk around your room like an explorer. Collect three very soft things and three hard things, and put them nicely into two different piles!

quick_recap: ⭐ Our amazing world is full of different objects of all shapes and colors.
⭐ We can use our hands to feel if an object is hard, soft, rough, or smooth.
⭐ Some objects are very heavy to pick up, while others are super light.
